verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a CRM, but the evidence never documents a recurring schedule, cron-style job or time-based recurring workflow. Copilot configuring "automations" doesn't specify scheduling or recurrence. Sequenced campaigns and on-demand enrichment ("whenever you choose") are adjacent features or one-off actions, not recurring scheduled jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
